mentions.name: TinyThoughts
mentions.description: A self-messaging app that supports tag-triggered webhooks, which fire based on tags assigned to messages. This enables automations such as auto-tweeting advice messages, auto-creating Linear tasks for `company` todos, and auto-starting a Cursor agent when messages are tagged `Cursor task`. A connector marketplace is planned so users can share these sub-connectors with other users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://tinythoughts.app, a self-messaging app

Today, I am implementing tag-triggered webhooks so they can get triggered based on the tags assigned to messages.
